observations.limitations: Only one tier can be assigned despite multiple hunks. No backend or database changes are shown, so systemic risk reduction cannot be established. Tier 3 requires broader capability or critical-path protection across components, which this isolated UI change does not demonstrate. The implementation could matter: it alters what users receive when they copy an AI-generated response, potentially changing downstream pasting behavior; however, without tests showing compatibility with existing workflows or release notes indicating adoption, benefit remains conjectural. This is bounded maintenance rather than a broad reliability improvement.
